Universal Celestial Goodnight, the new n.note: This pick describes a nightly show/event at Universal Epic Universe, not a distinct place -- the park entrance itself is already covered by the 'Universal Epic Universe' pick's photo.

Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring The Mup.note: Wikimedia Commons has several good photos of this coaster, but every one available shows the ride's prior 'Starring Aerosmith' branding and signage. The guide's pick describes the 2025 retheme to 'Starring The Muppets' (Aerosmith imagery removed); using an old-branded photo would misrepresent the attraction as it exists today, so this is treated as a gap rather than a mismatch, similar to using a different branch of a chain. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): searched Openverse for "Rock Roller Coaster Muppets Hollywood Studios"; the one result was an unrelated 2006 travel photo, and no post-2025 Muppets-branded photo of the coaster exists among CC-licensed results. No usable candidate found.

The after-dark water park parties.note: Describes a seasonal ticketed event format spanning multiple Orlando water parks, not a single place.

Level99 at Disney Springs.note: Level99 is a newly opened (2025) competitive-games venue; no Commons search (title, category, or geosearch near Disney Springs) returned any photo of it. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): searched Openverse for "Level99 Disney Springs"; zero results. No usable candidate found, unsurprising for a venue this new.

Eola Food Hall and the Mills 50 crawl.note: Combines a specific new food hall with a broader multi-venue restaurant crawl through the Mills 50 district; no single place to photograph, and Commons has no coverage of the newly opened Eola Food Hall itself either.
